name: Try the labeled local portrait and separate region settings
description: Loads a labeled schematic demonstration and confirms independent cosmetic layers.
steps: Select نمونه شماتیک برای آزمایش رابط
Select چشم‌ها, change its color and strength
Select لب‌ها and confirm the eyes settings remain independent
Check the NOT NEURAL V14 disclosure
expected: The portrait is visible, separate cosmetic controls remain operable, and the page explicitly does not claim to be the V14 neural model.

name: Prevent false safety approval on an unmodified portrait
description: Checks that an unpainted portrait cannot pass the protected-pixel check.
steps: Select نمونه شماتیک برای آزمایش رابط
Without drawing, click بررسی حفظ پیکسل‌های بیرون ماسک
expected: A visible warning says a makeup mask must be painted; validation does not report success.

name: Paint a layer then validate and export
description: Verifies masked photo rendering and file export at source resolution.
steps: Select نمونه شماتیک برای آزمایش رابط
Drag a short stroke over the model lips
Click بررسی حفظ پیکسل‌های بیرون ماسک
expected: An integrity success message appears and H-Beauty-Makeup-Preview.png downloads at the source dimensions.

name: Erase and reset before/after comparison
description: Confirms changes can be compared and reverted while retaining the underlying portrait.
steps: Select نمونه شماتیک برای آزمایش رابط
Paint a stroke then select پاک‌کن to erase some of it
Change the comparison slider and click بازنشانی
expected: The original can be compared with the edit, and reset clears the masks without removing the loaded portrait.
